name: Pension-Ferienwohnungen Inntal
beschreibung:
Overview

The Gästehaus Inntal is a family-run guesthouse operated by the Gründler family in Ebbs, in the Tyrolean Unterland, within the Kufstein region. It is centrally located near the Fohlenhof Ebbs and the recreational area surrounding the Zahmer Kaiser, as well as numerous cycling and hiking trails. The property offers spacious, comfortable rooms, most with a balcony, and holiday apartments for 4 to 7 people, each with a balcony and views of the Kaisergebirge mountains. Facilities include a cosy breakfast and lounge area with SAT-TV, free Wi-Fi throughout the house, and a covered pergola.

History/Background

The house is operated as a family-run guesthouse by the Gründler family. No specific historical details regarding its founding or development are documented on the property's own website or in the official sources available. What is reliably confirmed is its current use as a guesthouse with rooms and holiday apartments, and its address at Tafang 35, 6341 Ebbs.

Arrival

Travellers from Germany can reach Ebbs toll-free via the Inntal motorway, taking the Oberaudorf exit, or alternatively via the A 8 Munich–Salzburg motorway, taking the Frasdorf exit, then continuing via Aschau, Sachrang and the Niederndorferberg to Ebbs. From Innsbruck, the route is via the Kufstein Nord exit. The nearest train stations are Oberaudorf and Kufstein, both approximately 10 km away; from Kufstein, travellers can take the post bus or a taxi to Ebbs, and from Oberaudorf by taxi. A bus stop, which also serves as a ski bus stop, is located near the house. The airports of Innsbruck and Salzburg are around 90 km away each, and Munich Airport is around 110 km away. Private parking spaces are available on the property.

Tips

Overnight stays with breakfast in a double room are available from € 30.00 per person per day. Holiday apartments for 2 to 6 people are available from € 60.00 per day, plus a local tourist tax of € 3.50 per person per day. A final cleaning fee of € 25.00 to € 50.00 is charged per stay for the holiday apartments, and € 5.00 per day for dogs. Reserved rooms and holiday apartments can be cancelled free of charge up to one week before arrival. Only cash payments are accepted at the guesthouse; card payments are not available. The holiday apartments are named BLICK-WENDELSTEIN (for up to 5 people) and BLICK-NAUNSPITZE (for 2 to 6 people).

Best time to travel

The property advertises activities for both summer and winter on its website and is located along cycling and hiking trails, as well as near the ski bus. It is therefore well-suited as a base for excursions in both seasons. However, no specific recommended travel period is stated in the available sources.
